t: Update history: opening it shows all entries with their notes at once (tap an entry to fold it)
Update history: notes were missing (no notes) – fixed, older entries are filled in from the update list
Update history collapsed – tap the title to open it
Update button top right now reads New V1.7.x
System: Update history – every installed version with date, from → to and what was new
Update progress no longer jumps back to the page after a few seconds while the update is still loading
Core checks for updates every minute when not armed (can be switched off under System → Online update)
Core checks for updates by itself (1 min after Wi-Fi connects, then every 6 h, never while armed)
New update: green button top right and green dot on System, big green card at the top of System with what is new and Update now
Info about the last update only under System: green until OK, then grey
After an update, the latest changes stay visible as info: green banner at the top until you tap OK, and always under System → Update
Ride player: new tiles LiDAR distance and AUTO steering/throttle (what the Core steers when following or in shadow mode)
Drift & Auto: Follow a ride – the Core drives a recorded or virtual ride by itself (MSP RC Override), with shadow mode
Optional LiDAR distance sensor (e.g. MicoAir MT-15): brakes in AUTO, distance saved in every ride
Virtual rides: smooth track without jitter or zig-zag, car stands still when stopped, smoother attitude
Virtual rides faster and adjustable: top speed, corner speed, acceleration, styles gentle/normal/wild/custom, average speed shown; Close button left
Drift page shows only rides with drift data
Player: Web page button returns to the page you came from, page remembers the open tab, Drift page skips old rides without drift data
Buttons: channel overview incl. INAV modes read from the FC (Arm, AUTO, ...) and the msp_override_channels value
